mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation (order_id, user_id, content, score, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{score}, NOW())
mapper.sql: SELECT e.evaluation_id AS evaluationId, e.order_id AS orderId, e.user_id AS buyerId, bu.username AS buyerName, o.seller_id AS sellerId, o.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, e.score, e.content, e.create_time AS createTime FROM evaluation e JOIN orders o ON e.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN `user` bu ON e.user_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.goods_id
mapper.select:
SELECT e.order_id AS orderId, e.evaluation_id AS evaluationId, e.score FROM evaluation e WHERE e.order_id IN
#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(e.score), 1), 0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star5, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.score = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star4, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.score = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star3, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.score = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star2, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS star1 FROM evaluation e JOIN orders o ON e.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId}
WHERE o.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC, e.evaluation_id DESC
